rule.generic: A table contains the numbers starting from 1. Two players take turns covering one number at a time until only two numbers remain. If the sum of the two remaining numbers is even, the first player wins; if it is odd, the second player wins.
rule.upTo: A table contains the numbers 1 to {{maxNumber}}. Two players take turns covering one number at a time until only two numbers remain. If the sum of the two remaining numbers is even, the first player wins; if it is odd, the second player wins.

step: Click a number to cover it.
